description: Its 'good' verdict is provisional until the Elixir side is as fast as we can make it. Ideas: Tuple/:array rows, parallel chunking of the catalog per request, early cut-off on the Elixir side (needs defk-9vl for the defk side). Re-run the load test and update the app README. If Elixir comes within 2x, the verdict becomes marginal and Elixir is the recommendation: record that as a result.
title: Optimise the Elixir baseline: fuzzy_search app
